fields.label: Text
fields.default:
Established in **2021 in Spring, Texas**, SreeNarthana Natyalaya is a center dedicated to excellence in Bharatanatyam, blending tradition, discipline, and artistic refinement.

Under the distinguished guidance of **Smt. Sreenandini Jayaram**, we nurture more than dancers — we nurture artists grounded in technique, expressive depth, and cultural heritage. Our training instills discipline, confidence, and devotion, shaping performers who carry the timeless spirit of Bharatanatyam with poise and authenticity.

fields.label: Paragraph 1
fields.default: Smt. Sreenandini Jayaram, the visionary founder of SreeNarthana Natyalaya, brings decades of experience in Bharatanatyam to the dance community of Spring, Texas and surrounding areas.

fields.label: Paragraph 2

fields.default: Beginning her journey at a young age, Sreenandini Jayaram has evolved into a committed performer, choreographer, and mentor. Her teaching philosophy blends traditional rigor with contemporary sensitivity, ensuring that every student grows not only as a dancer but also as a custodian of cultural heritage.

fields.label: Review 1 — text
fields.default: Sreenandini is a wonderful teacher who has truly sparked my daughter's (Pradhita's) interest in dance. Thanks to her encouragement and support, Pradhita has transformed from a shy child into a more confident and social individual.

fields.label: Review 2 — text
fields.default:
Bharatanatyam being a classical art form derives its beauty from precision, discipline, and a unique style. Unlike many commercial dance classes that focus on quickly completing lessons, this institution is deeply committed to teaching proper posture, mudras, and foundational techniques. Students are promoted only after achieving the required level of proficiency, with no compromises in quality.
        Respect for the art form is emphasized, ensuring students understand its cultural significance. 

        The dedication and effort invested in perfecting each recital make every performance exceptional.

        My child has been learning here for four years, and it has been a joy to witness her growth. I am proud to be part of an institution where the true values of Bharatanatyam are preserved.

fields.label: Review 3 — text
fields.default: We joined Ms. Nandini's Sree Narthana Natyalaya a few years back and are grateful for that decision. She is a disciplined and dedicated teacher and a role model. Both my daughters have gained confidence and learned to dance with grace and dignity. We look forward to the institution's excellence spreading to many more students.

fields.label: Review 4 — text
fields.default: My two daughters, aged 8 and 5, attend Bharatanatyam classes here. Ms. Nandini is patient, kind, and makes learning enjoyable. We've seen great improvement in their confidence and interest in dance. Highly recommended.

fields.label: Review 5 — text
fields.default: Wonderful teaching and a very positive environment.

fields.label: Review 6 — text
fields.default: As a parent, I am incredibly grateful for SreeNandini Jayaram, our guru, whose patience and creativity shine through in every Bharatanatyam class. She has truly nurtured both of our daughters’ interest and love for dance, while building strong technique and confidence. It is heartwarming to see their enthusiasm grow and their skills flourish under such thoughtful and dedicated guidance.
